title: Kestrel Care Rewards Points Expiry — Desk Training Notes
content:
**The rule.** At a **Kestrel Care Rewards** level where points expire, the whole unconverted points balance expires when the level's inactivity period, in calendar months, passes without any entry crediting earned points or goodwill points to the membership; where the counting reaches a month shorter than the starting day, the month-end falls back to the last day of that shorter month. Any such earning entry restarts the period. At a level where points do not expire, points never expire while the membership is open. All points and Kestrel Cash lapse when the membership closes.

## Expiry by level

| Level | Unconverted points expire after inactivity | Inactivity period (calendar months) |
|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Care Rewards Member | yes | 12 |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Silver | yes | 12 |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Gold | yes | 18 |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Platinum | yes | 24 |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Plus Monthly | no | 0 (not applicable) |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Plus Annual | no | 0 (not applicable) |

## Questions answered

**What starts the inactivity period?** The most recent entry crediting earned points or goodwill points. Each new entry of either kind restarts the period.

**How are the months counted?** In calendar months from the date of that entry. When the starting day does not exist in the month the count reaches, the last day of that month is used.

*Hypothetical dates:* a member at Kestrel Care Rewards Gold whose latest earning entry is dated 31 March has an 18-month period that runs to 30 September of the following year, since September has no 31st. The same entry at Kestrel Care Rewards Member runs 12 months, to 31 March of the following year. An entry dated 31 August at Kestrel Care Rewards Platinum runs 24 months, to 31 August two years later.

**How much expires?** The whole unconverted points balance, not only the points credited before a certain date.

**Does a Kestrel Cash redemption restart the period?** The period is measured only by entries crediting earned points or goodwill points; a redemption is not such an entry.

**A new earning entry arrives before the period runs out — what happens?** The period restarts from that entry, and nothing expires on the earlier date.

**Do points expire for a Kestrel Care Rewards Plus Monthly or Kestrel Care Rewards Plus Annual member?** No. At those levels points do not expire while the membership is open.

**What happens to points and Kestrel Cash when the membership closes?** All points and all Kestrel Cash lapse, at every level.
